name: Dispose of a former employee’s personal data after retention

references.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 s.25 (https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/PDPA2012?ProvIds=pr25-); Income Tax Act 1947 s.67(1)(a) (https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/ITA1947?ProvIds=pr67-): records kept 5 years from the year of assessment; IRAS, Record keeping requirements (read 2026-10-07): a financial year ending in 2022 (YA 2023) is kept till 31 Dec 2027. Personal Data Protection Act 2012 s.25 then requires ceasing to retain the personal data.
